method: Manual case-by-case contract review plus image AST symbol verification and local tests of the named templates. No live-model generation or device execution for this audit.

discovery.note: Read-only capabilities template; device_id optional/UNKNOWN. No peripheral constructors except display. Node/symbol discovery is not ownership or wiring.

display.note: Integer geometry and actual orientation. Backlight 0–100 with saved value; no direct PWM10. Thai font requires a real font file.

Display.__init__.signature: self, width: int=-1, height: int=-1, format: maix._maix.image.Format=..., device: str=None, open: bool=True

Image.__init__.signature: self, width: int, height: int, format: Format=...

Image.draw_rect.signature: self, x: int, y: int, w: int, h: int, color: Color, thickness: int=1

Image.draw_line.signature: self, x1: int, y1: int, x2: int, y2: int, color: Color, thickness: int=1

Image.draw_circle.signature: self, x: int, y: int, radius: int, color: Color, thickness: int=1

Image.draw_string.signature: self, x: int, y: int, textstring: str, color: Color=..., scale: float=1, thickness: int=-1, wrap: bool=True, wrap_space: int=4, font: str=''

touch.note: One [x,y,pressed] point; pressed-gated hit tests, edge detection and fit offsets. No multi-touch guarantee.

adc.note: Plus source maps ADC0 to S1/S2. Use measured MP-021 bands, not old constants; no guaranteed close/deinit.

ADC.__init__.signature: self, pin: int, resolution: int, vref: float=-1

led.note: Verify led-user node, ownership and original active trigger/brightness before writes. Restore bracketed active trigger; on/off is not PWM dimming.

gpio.note: Source aliases are not physical PCB proof. P24/IO7 unresolved. No get_pin_function or GPIO.close declaration. Reserve A16/A17; fixture and safe LOW/START gate required.

GPIO.__init__.signature: self, pin: str, mode: Mode=..., pull: Pull=...

pwm.note: ID/function/pin are separate; duty is percent. C906Servo helper not found at selected image paths. No IO7 actuation until channel/backend proven.

PWM.__init__.signature: self, id: int, freq: int=1000, duty: float=0, enable: bool=True, duty_val: int=-1

i2c.note: Confirm external backend/pins/ownership and module protocol first. Software bus 5 is not automatically present. No invented readfrom timeout or implicit insmod.

I2C.__init__.signature: self, id: int, mode: Mode, freq: int=100000, addr_size: AddrSize=...

imu.note: DUAL contract is six axes; seventh temperature not guaranteed. No unconditional [6], x10 conversion, sign remap or unsupported hardware tap.

IMU.__init__.signature: self, driver: str, i2c_bus: int=-1, addr: int=107, freq: int=400000, mode: Mode=..., acc_scale: AccScale=..., acc_odr: AccOdr=..., gyro_scale: GyroScale=..., gyro_odr: GyroOdr=..., block: bool=True

rtc.note: Module bm8563, not rtc. Actual chip/bus and RTC/NTP ownership need confirmation. Read-only kernel node preferred; no time writes or automatic service changes.

uart.note: Read timeout is milliseconds, 0 immediate and -1 blocking. Confirm user connector and free port; do not open UART0/A16/A17 owned by the protocol.

UART.__init__.signature: self, port: str='', baudrate: int=115200, databits: BITS=..., parity: PARITY=..., stopbits: STOP=..., flow_ctrl: FLOW_CTRL=...

camera.note: Real sensor/frame geometry, RGB888 and FPS from actual successful frames. Each overlay before show; close camera. QR data never executes commands.

Camera.__init__.signature: self, width: int=-1, height: int=-1, format: maix._maix.image.Format=..., device: str=None, fps: float=-1, buff_num: int=3, open: bool=True, raw: bool=False

Camera.read.signature: self, buff: capsule=None, buff_size: int=0, block: bool=True, block_ms: int=-1

Image.find_blobs.signature: self, thresholds: list[list[int]]=[], invert: bool=False, roi: list[int]=[], x_stride: int=2, y_stride: int=1, area_threshold: int=10, pixels_threshold: int=10, merge: bool=False, margin: int=0, x_hist_bins_max: int=0, y_hist_bins_max: int=0

audio.note: Player.stop/close absent and Player.volume documented unsupported. Use low-amplitude raw PCM and short chunks; recorder.record() can be empty, finish recorder, no guessed audio.read/close.

Player.__init__.signature: self, path: str='', sample_rate: int=48000, format: Format=..., channel: int=1

Recorder.__init__.signature: self, path: str='', sample_rate: int=48000, format: Format=..., channel: int=1

network.note: Use Python socket/urllib/http.server with finite timeout. maix.http is not HTTP GET/POST. MQTT/WebSocket packages and endpoints must be supplied/verified; no pip or RNDIS changes.

files.note: Python 3.11 pathlib/os/json/csv/hashlib/wave as applicable. Writable unique test directory, bounded bytes, atomic replace on same filesystem. No system files, full-card or forced-power-loss tests.

models.note: Requires actual compatible model/labels/input and audio preprocessing. API presence is not model or output compatibility; no fake inference.

Classifier.classify.signature: self, img: maix._maix.image.Image, softmax: bool=True, fit: maix._maix.image.Fit=...

YOLOv5.detect.signature: self, img: maix._maix.image.Image, conf_th: float=0.5, iou_th: float=0.45, fit: maix._maix.image.Fit=...

YOLOv8.detect.signature: self, img: maix._maix.image.Image, conf_th: float=0.5, iou_th: float=0.45, fit: maix._maix.image.Fit=..., keypoint_th: float=0.5

YOLO11.detect.signature: self, img: maix._maix.image.Image, conf_th: float=0.5, iou_th: float=0.45, fit: maix._maix.image.Fit=..., keypoint_th: float=0.5

lifecycle.note: User-operated Run/Stop; adapter owns Launcher/process group. Intentionally failing tests expect nonzero exits. No physical PASS from compile/upload; synthetic fixtures are not newer installed versions.

extensions.note: Discovery/manual procedure only until actual exposed bus/driver/ownership and power configuration are proven. No USB role switch, kernel module loading or motor actuation by default.
